::: {.callout-important title="This is not a safety section"}
This website does not contain safety information. Use your board rules, training, supervision, and your professional experience and judgement.

These photos show the machine or setup. They do not show every safe action.
:::

Your teacher will choose the tools for your shop.

## Measure and mark

::: {.phone-machine-section}
::: {.phone-machine-visual}
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/combination-square-in-use.jpg" alt="A combination square marking a line on wood."><figcaption>Ruler and square</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/original-plan.png" alt="The measured plan for the two phone-holder parts."><figcaption>Mark these shapes</figcaption></figure>
:::

A ruler and square copy the sizes from the plan to the wood.
:::

## Cut the outside

::: {.phone-machine-section}
::: {.phone-machine-visual}
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/band-saw-guarded-hse.jpg" alt="A band saw set up with the blade guide close to the work, a fence, and a push stick nearby."><figcaption>Band saw: guide, fence, and push stick</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/scroll-saw-guarded-osha.jpg" alt="A scroll saw with a blade guard and hold-down."><figcaption>Scroll saw: guarded machine</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/two-parts.jpg" alt="Two phone-holder parts cut from sheet wood."><figcaption>Cut parts</figcaption></figure>
:::

A hand saw, scroll saw, or band saw cuts the parts and outside shape.

Safety sources: [CCOHS band saws](https://www.ccohs.ca/oshanswers/safety_haz/woodwork/band_saw.html) and [OSHA scroll saws](https://www.osha.gov/etools/machine-guarding/saws/scroll)
:::

## Drill an opening

::: {.phone-machine-section}
::: {.phone-machine-visual}
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/drill-press-clamped-cdc.jpg" alt="A drill press with the work held in a metal vise."><figcaption>Drill press: work held in a vise</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/original-plan.png" alt="A phone-holder plan with openings marked on the parts."><figcaption>Start at the marked point</figcaption></figure>
:::

The drill press starts a round opening at the marked point.

Safety source: [WorkSafeBC drill presses](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/resources/health-safety/hazard-alerts/using-drill-presses-safely)
:::

## Cut the slots

::: {.phone-machine-section}
::: {.phone-machine-visual}
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/coping-saw.jpg" alt="A coping saw resting on marked plywood."><figcaption>Coping saw</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/scroll-saw-guarded-osha.jpg" alt="A scroll saw with a blade guard and hold-down."><figcaption>Scroll saw</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/two-parts.jpg" alt="Two phone-holder parts with narrow joining slots."><figcaption>Slots join the parts</figcaption></figure>
:::

The narrow blade cuts the slots that join the two parts.
:::

## Shape and finish

::: {.phone-machine-section}
::: {.phone-machine-visual}
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/belt-disc-sander.jpg" alt="A workshop belt and disc sander."><figcaption>Edge sander or belt sander: outside edges</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/orbital-sander.jpg" alt="A random orbital sander."><figcaption>Orbital sander: flat faces</figcaption></figure>
<figure><img src="../../assets/phone-holder/tools/hand-sanding.jpg" alt="A hand sanding a small piece of wood."><figcaption>By hand: small details</figcaption></figure>
:::

Sand the faces, outside edges, and inside curves until they are smooth. An oscillating sander or drum sander can smooth inside curves.

Safety sources: [CCOHS sanders](https://www.ccohs.ca/oshanswers/safety_haz/woodwork/sander_b.html) and [NIOSH wood-dust control](https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/docs/hazardcontrol/hc8.html)

![Painted Kermit and Bob Ross phone holders made from shaped and sanded parts.](../../assets/phone-holder/westdale/kermit-bob-ross.jpg){.phone-result-photo}
:::
